contentText: Jury selection began on Monday in the murder trial of an ex-street gang leader accused of masterminding the drive-by shooting death of hip-hop star Tupac Shakur three decades ago in Las Vegas; Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, is charged in Clark County, ⁠Nevada, with orchestrating the killing, but not pulling the trigger. He has pleaded not guilty. He faces a potential life sentence without parole if convicted. Our correspondent Wassim Cornet tells us more.
